title: Choosing what to carry into a level
target: How to decide what your crew brings, based on the gear and loot behaviour the game defines, so the run survives its own mistakes.
version: R.E.P.O. v0.4.0, as installed for this build (see the sources page for the exact version string)
prerequisites: A crew and a level to enter
Access to the shop between runs

steps.do: Take a walkie-talkie before you take a second weapon.
steps.because: the walkie-talkie is its own item and is what keeps a split crew in contact (ItemWalkieTalkie)

steps.do: Bring one revive item even if it leaves a hand empty.
steps.because: reviving a crew member uses a dedicated item rather than a free action (ItemReviveItem)

steps.do: Decide in advance how many hands go to loot.
steps.because: valuables are individual objects of very different size and each one takes carrying attention (GumballValuable, BlenderValuable, TrafficLightValuable)

steps.do: Leave room for a boxed valuable, which is easy to walk past.
steps.because: at least one valuable comes in a box you can pick up (ItemValuableBox)

commonMistakes: Bringing weapons and no way to talk.
Assuming a revive will be available when it is needed.
Filling every hand with loot and losing the ability to fight at all.
sources: This installation of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
